import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_absxm1pabsxpabsxp1eqxp2_0leqxleq1
  (x : ℝ)
  (h₀ : abs (x - 1) + abs x + abs (x + 1) = x + 2) :
  0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Case analysis on the sign of x-1, x, and x+1
  by_cases h₁ : x ≥ 1
  · -- Case x ≥ 1: |x-1| = x-1, |x| = x, |x+1| = x+1
    have h₂ : abs (x - 1) = x - 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg]
      linarith
    have h₃ : abs x = x := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg]
      linarith
    have h₄ : abs (x + 1) = x + 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg]
      linarith
    rw [h₂, h₃, h₄] at h₀
    have h₅ : x = 1 := by linarith
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · -- Case x < 1
    by_cases h₂ : x ≥ 0
    · -- Subcase 0 ≤ x < 1: |x-1| = 1-x, |x| = x, |x+1| = x+1
      have h₃ : abs (x - 1) = 1 - x := by
        rw [abs_of_nonpos]
        linarith
      have h₄ : abs x = x := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg]
        linarith
      have h₅ : abs (x + 1) = x + 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg]
        linarith
      rw [h₃, h₄, h₅] at h₀
      have h₆ : True := by linarith
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · -- Subcase x < 0
      have h₃ : x < 0 := by linarith
      by_cases h₄ : x ≥ -1
      · -- Subcase -1 ≤ x < 0: |x-1| = 1-x, |x| = -x, |x+1| = x+1
        have h₅ : abs (x - 1) = 1 - x := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos]
          linarith
        have h₆ : abs x = -x := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos]
          linarith
        have h₇ : abs (x + 1) = x + 1 := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg]
          linarith
        rw [h₅, h₆, h₇] at h₀
        have h₈ : False := by linarith
        exfalso
        exact h₈
      · -- Subcase x < -1: |x-1| = 1-x, |x| = -x, |x+1| = -x-1
        have h₅ : abs (x - 1) = 1 - x := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos]
          linarith
        have h₆ : abs x = -x := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos]
          linarith
        have h₇ : abs (x + 1) = -(x + 1) := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos]
          linarith
        rw [h₅, h₆, h₇] at h₀
        have h₈ : False := by linarith
        exfalso
        exact h₈
